text:
Asha: FYI ran into a weird one — someone saved a route view while a model was pinned and when others loaded it the route actually changed. Budget alarm. :grimacing:
Tom: Yikes. That sounds like saved views are persisting UI state and applying it on load. We should never mutate routing implicitly.
Ravi: Agreed. Proposal: saved views = filters+layout only. If a pinned model exists it becomes a "preferred_model" hint on the saved object, but loading a saved view never calls route.update by default.
Nora: UI idea: when a saved view has a preferred model, show a small non-actionable banner: "This view prefers redwood/neo-13b-q2 (preview only)." Include a cost delta pill and an "Apply to route" CTA.
Asha: Also need approval flow for Dedicated customers when apply would increase cost or impact compliance. The CTA should open a modal listing cost delta, cert levels, and an "Apply (request approval)" option.
Tom: API contract sketch: savedQuery row adds preferred_model_id (nullable) and preview_meta (small json string). savedQueries.create(..., preferred_model_id, force_apply=false). force_apply=true allowed only for org-admins.
Ravi: Telemetry: saved_query.load {mode:preview}, saved_query.apply.request and saved_query.apply.result {accepted|rejected|missing_model}. Also saved_query.load.missing_model=true when model not in catalog.
Nora: Edge case: archived model ids. If preferred model missing show "model unavailable" and fallback to route default. Do not auto-apply.
Asha: Ops note — keep savedQuery rows tiny so listing remains cheap. Avoid embedding routing rules. Store references only.
deploy-bot: feature/saved-view-preview deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
Tom: Can we get a quick Console POC with the banner + pill so PM/design can test? I'll add an acceptance test ensuring loading a saved view without pressing apply does not hit the route update endpoint.
Ravi: I'll write the RFC with schema examples and the telemetry key list and link it in the PR.
Nora: I'll add Figma frames for the banner/modal. TL;DR: saved views non-destructive by default, preferred_model opt-in as preview, explicit apply flow with audit/approval, and telemetry for observability.
Asha: Thanks — I'll capture this in the PM spec and schedule a short sync after staging validation.
